title: Comment on arXiv:2106.08363v3 [math.NA], E. Abreu, A. Espirito Santo, W. Lambert, and J. Perez, Convergence of a Lagrangian--Eulerian scheme by a weak asymptotic analysis for one-dimensional hyperbolic problems
summary: This Comment concerns arXiv:2106.08363v3 [math.NA] by E. Abreu, A. Espirito Santo, W. Lambert and J. Perez, published in Numer. Methods Partial Differential Equations 39 (2023) 2400-2443. That article builds its scheme on space-time control volumes whose lateral boundaries, called "no-flow curves", solve dsigma/dt = H(u)/u and are presented as new. We show, equation by equation, that this object is the space-time integral curve of the locally conservative Eulerian-Lagrangian method of Douglas, Pereira and Yeh [Comput. Geosci. 4 (2000) 1-40], that the no-flow region is the tube those curves…
